question: Annie Besant founded the Central Hindu College at Banaras which she later handed over to __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madan Mohan Malviya**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Annie Besant founded the Central Hindu College at Banaras **and **later gifted it to Pandit Madan Mohan Malviya.**
 
• Madan Mohan Malaviya 
 
 
• He is remembered for his role in ending the Indian indenture system, especially in the Caribbean.
 
• He was given the title of ‘Mahamana’ by Rabindranath Tagore and the second President of India, Dr. S. Radhakrishnan gave him the status of a ‘Karmayogi’.
 
• He worked immensely for Hindu-Muslim unity.
 
• He is known to have given famous speeches on communal harmony.
 
• He helped establish the Hindu Mahasabha (“Great Society of Hindus”) in 1906, which brought diverse local Hindu nationalist movements together.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Annie Besant is Popularly known as Annie Wood.
 
• She was a reputed theosophist, women's rights activist, writer, and orator.
 
• In 1916, along with Lokmanya Tilak, she launched the Home Rule League.
 
• She was selected as the first woman president of the Indian National Congress in 1917.
 
• She was declared a World Teacher after her lecture on Theosophy in 1926.
